beats.care: Applying next year? WBJEEB counselling and the WBCAP portal are where most Bengal college seats get filled.
beats.what: WBJEEB counselling filled 27,599 engineering, technology and pharmacy seats this year, up from 15,729 in 2025.
beats.why: Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay shared the official data. Most seats were filled through centralised counselling and the WBCAP portal.

cards.body: Up from 2.62 lakh in 2025, through the WBCAP and WBDAP portals.
cards.caption: UG college admissions in 2026

cards.body: 2,156 students moved from a centralised seat to a college they preferred through decentralised counselling.

opts: Admissions grew by about three-quarters over last year
cards.q: What does a 75.4% rise in admissions mean?
cards.why: 27,599 is about 1.75 times last year's 15,729, so admissions grew by roughly three-quarters.

hook: Engineering admissions in Bengal jumped *75.4%* in one year

learn.t: About 1.3 lakh more students got UG college seats in Bengal this year than in 2025.

sources.name: Millennium Post
sources.title: WBJEEB admissions surge 75.4%, UG college admissions up 49.9%

tldr: Engineering and pharmacy admissions in Bengal rose 75.4% this year and UG college admissions rose 49.9%, the higher education minister said.
